<subject>Re: Monkey Business</subject>
<body>
I'm an expert at being a rabid fan and excellent arm chair manager.  I keep waiting for the Kalgoorlie Ironworks to call for advice....





"Devin King" <devin.king@tasmanridge.com.au> on 29/03/2024 04:28 PM
To: <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au>
cc:  

Subject: Re: Monkey Business

Sorry for the late notice - have been underwater this week trying to get Pilbara North and Murchison Logistics buttoned up, and just realized today that I needed to get on this.  Will hope to see you there and try to find another time we can go. My understanding from all is that you are the resident baseball expert (next to Robert Stanley).

Best regards.

cgt

<quoted>
>>> <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au> 29/03/24 04:12PM >>>

I would love to take you up on it, but I'm already lined up to go.  I'll take a raincheck!

Thanks for thinking of me.

Adam




"Devin King" <devin.king@tasmanridge.com.au> on 29/03/2024 04:07:45 PM

To:   <margaret.cox@tasmanridge.com.au>, <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au>, <eric.moore@tasmanridge.com.au>
cc:

Subject:  Monkey Business

My recollection is that each of you is somewhat of a baseball fan, as I am. I just happen to have 4 great seats for Opening Day at Tasman Ridge Field, for which I very much need company to help me enjoy.  I would love it if each of you could join me.  The game starts at 4:05 pm, so it might require leaving the office a little early.  But of course we would be discussing serious business the entire time so that it would be fully justifiable to anyone interested.  I will bring my legal pad to take notes.

Let me know.  Hope you can come.

cgt
